title: Rava bar Sharshom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Bava Batra 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.32b.9) relates that a report spread about him that he was consuming orphans’ land. Abaye said to him: “Tell me the actual facts of the case,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara introduces the rumor and Abaye’s request for Rava’s account. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3095&lang=en) also places Rava bar Sharshom before Abaye in this passage.
